fullContentHtml:
UPPSC Various Post Online Form 2025 – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the notification for the Direct, Lecturer, Professor and Other Various Post. This recruitment has been issued for 36 posts. Online applying process for UPPSC Various Post Recruitment 2025 has started from 24 March 2025 & the candidates can apply till 24 April 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for UPPSC Various Post Recruitment 2025 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 24 March 2025
  • Last Date : 24 April 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 24 April 2025
  • Correction Last Date : 01 May 2025
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 105/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 65/-
  • PH : Rs. 25/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification (English)
  • Download Notification (Hindi)
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UPPSC Various Post Online Form 2025?

UPPSC Various Post Online Form 2025 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
